stem.text: A wave on the surface of water passes through a gap between two barriers and is diffracted, as shown.

stem.alt: Straight wavefronts approaching a gap between two barriers, with curved wavefronts spreading out on the other side; labels barrier at the top and bottom of the gap, and an arrow showing the direction of the incoming wave.

stem.text: What happens when the frequency of the wave is halved?

D.text: The same amount of diffraction is observed.
